messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH latency on hosted-inference-prod (Service: hosted-inference) — Escalation policy: inference-latency. Alert key: PD12345. Link: https://pagerduty.com/alerts/PD12345
Alicia: ack
Marc: saw the escalation, I'm awake — will take if Alicia can't respond in 2m
Alicia: sorry incoming meeting, mobile DND on, didn't see page. trying to connect now
incident-bot: Escalation: paged Manager Lydia after 2m no ack from primary
Lydia: picking up, calling primary and secondary. what's the impact? any customer-facing errors?
Tom: latency spike — p95 -> ~8s, p99 ~12s for text-generation endpoints; a handful of 503s in last 3m. support ticket count +2.
Priya: CS: 3 customers reported timeouts on embeddings endpoint, they want an ETA.
Marc: quick check — gpu-pool-3 showing queue saturation, concurrency ~95%. KV cache miss rate up ~4x.
Alicia: I'm on laptop now. can someone run `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-pool-3` and tail the runtime logs?
Tom: run this:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-pool-3
kubectl logs -n inference $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-pool-3 -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -c inference-runtime --tail=200
```
Tom: logs show repeated RPC timeouts to redis at 10.0.4.12, backlog increasing.
Marc: I'm going to temporarily reroute traffic away from gpu-pool-3 -> prefer gpu-pool-1 for prod/us-east.
incident-bot: Routing change requested by Marc. Applying policy: prod/region/us-east -> prefer gpu-pool-1.
Marc: routing change applied — confirmation received.
Alicia: running smoke tests against gpu-pool-1, hitting small sample now.
Priya: CS posting update to affected customers: "Investigating increased latency; mitigation in progress, next update in 15m" :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lydia: good. keep me posted. if manager escalation fires again escalate to execs.
Tom: also restarted two pods on gpu-pool-3 to clear stuck connections:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n inference --grace-period=30
```
Marc: temporary mitigation done — p95 back down to ~400ms. continuing to monitor.
Alicia: leaving notes in incident doc https://redwood.in/cases/INC-2026-451 with immediate steps taken.
Priya: customers updated at +10m. one asked for status page link.
Lydia: handoff — Alicia, can you hand primary to Marc while you finish meetings?
Alicia: handing off. Marc, you're primary for the next 90m.
Marc: acknowledged. will monitor closely for 30m then follow PD policy if it re-fires.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (auto-closed) after routing change and pod restarts.
Tom: opening INF-789 for followups — likely root cause: redis throttling under burst, needs capacity/connection tuning.
Alicia: +1 to postmortem. Also note mobile DND caused missed primary ack — recommend PD schedule override or slack notify integration.
Priya: adding affected customer list to ticket and will confirm once all customers see normal behavior.
Lydia: retrospective item: ensure manager escalation path doesn't page execs until confirmed impact.
Tom: followups: increase redis capacity in us-east, add cache warmups during deploys, tune autoscaler for gpu-pool-3.
Marc: final handoff: monitoring until 20:30 PT, will message when clear.
Priya: closing loop with customers now — will update thread once confirmations in.
Alicia: thanks all — signing off.
incident-bot: thread archived
